title: Spicy Carbonara Pasta
description: A spicy twist on the classic Italian pasta dish, featuring peppery flavors and a creamy sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the carbonara sauce over medium heat.
Add the sliced peppers to the skillet and cook until they begin to soften.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the peppers and sauce.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with parmesan cheese.
